findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be prepared in the back kitchen. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bucket made prepared and tested at 200 ppm Quat. Ensure a sanitizer solution is prepared and available in both the kitchen and service area.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed a can opener to be soiled with rust. Discussed with PIC, can opener will be cleaned and put through the wash, rinse, sanitize process. Ensure can opener is being cleaned at a frequency that prevents rust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Observed a single service cup to be resting in Paprika container. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper utensil usage and cup was discarded. Ensure utensils are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the inside of microwave to be soiled with food debris accumulation. Discussed with PIC, microwave will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop to be resting in bottom of mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper mop storage and mop was moved to mop ringer. Ensure after use, mops are stored in a way that prevents any contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas to have food debris accumulation:
1) The seasoning lids were observed to have an accumulation of food debris.
2) The inside top of microwave was observed to have food debris accumulation.

Discussed with PIC, the following areas will be cleaned. Ensure non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed hand sink caulking to be coming apart. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure caulking is being replaced as needed.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed excess food splash and debris to be present on cardboard in flooring of walk in freezer. Discussed with PIC, cardboard will be replaced. Ensure walk in freezer flooring is replace at a frequency that prevents food debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(3) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (3) Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as FOOD preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, WAREWASHING areas, toilet rooms, mobile FOOD ESTABLISHMENT SERVICING AREAS, and areas subject to flushing or spray cleaning methods.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed baklava cakes to be removed from original packaging without a date marking available. Discussed with PIC, education on proper date marking was provided and stickers were placed on baklava. Ensure any TCS item removed from its original packaging is properly date marked.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employee to not use a barrier when turning off hand washing faucet. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper handwashing technique, and the employee rewashed their hands. Ensure proper handwashing practices are followed.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed the front display prep cooler to be cold holding TCS items at 50F. Discussed with PIC, TCS item kept in prep cooler were all prepped 2 hours before service. A time as control procedure has been set for TCS items kept in cooler. During inspection, items within cooler dropped to below 41F, COS. Inspector will spot check cooler in the following days to ensure cooler is correctly working. Ensure any TCS item being cold held is kept at or below 41F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.
